mapper.insert: INSERT INTO squad_template (tenant_id, name, description, squad_size, icon, tags, content_json, status, is_deleted) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{squadSize}, #{icon}, #{tags}, #{contentJson}, #{status}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM squad_template WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM squad_template WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND (tenant_id IS NULL OR tenant_id = #{tenantId}) ORDER BY squad_size ASC, id ASC
